maps.name: The Playground
maps.description: A castle courtyard with stone walls, winding lanes and a crystal worth protecting. Build your route, recruit the Blue Knight guards, and meet the next wave on your own terms.
maps.alt: An aerial in-game view of the Playground's castle courtyard, guard posts and crystal in Brickhold.

game.title: Brickhold
game.description: The kingdom's crystals are under attack. Build traps, shape enemy routes and fight alongside your defenses, alone or with up to three friends.
